title: VXAce Looking for a very old Vx Ace script, hope/pray somebody here knows it.

posts.author: Wolfsiege
posts.body:
Ok, so long ago there was this script for RPG maker vx ace called something generic like Choice Options. It wasn’t Hime’s Choice Options or any other choice option script that makes so you have to use script calls.
Instead you placed tags like dialogue tags (like them \n[x]) on the choices of the choice list and somehow those tags worked when you booted the thing up. There were tags to hide the choice, and some to disable the choice which would grey it out.
Most importantly this script also worked somewhat like Yanfly’s Message System and had a variable you could set for visible choice rows on screen at all times and even merged separate choice options together into a single list the player could scroll through.
It was a very amazing script and until very recently I used it a lot, but then I had to format my computer due to some troubles and I had basically nothing saved. Together with that I lost this script and also lost a big repository folder I had with a bunch of other old-ass VX ACE scripts, because I’m a fool who doesn’t save stuff.
Now I’m searching for this thing once more but no matter what, I just can’t find it. So I hope that maybe, other people will know where I can find it, or perhaps have it themselves and can give it to me maybe…
Anyway, I know this script exists and I'm not just making it up because I was using it very recently too!
